name: Standard Bank Group Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): H1 2026 column prepended from the Standard Bank Group 1H26 results, condensed consolidated income statement in the analysis of interim financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. ZAR million scaled to absolute ZAR: Total net income 98,981; Operating expenses 50,348; Profit before indirect taxation 42,890; Indirect taxation 2,237; Profit before direct taxation 40,653; Direct taxation 10,540; Profit for the period 30,113; Attributable to ordinary shareholders 26,193; basic earnings per ordinary share 1,615.6 cents. The JSE listing resolves this file first (sym SBK.JO), so the H1 2026 column had to be written here as well as to SBK__income.json or it would not render on the JSE board. Operating expenses and direct taxation are carried positive to match the FY2025 basis in this file.
